thread.title: Merrill Lynch Keeps a Hold Rating on Apple (AAPL)

author: Carrie Williams
title: Merrill Lynch Keeps a Hold Rating on Apple (AAPL)
text:
Carrie Williams 22 AM EDT SHARE ON:
Merrill Lynch analyst Wamsi Mohan maintained a Hold rating on Apple ( AAPL ) today and set a price target of $196 . The company’s shares closed yesterday at $157.92, close to its 52-week low of $146.59.
According to TipRanks.com , Mohan is a 4-star analyst with an average return of 7.7% and a 53.4% success rate. Mohan covers the Consumer Goods sector, focusing on stocks such as Pure Storage Inc, Seagate Tech, and 3D Systems.
Apple has an analyst consensus of Moderate Buy, with a price target consensus of $197.22, which is a 24.9% upside from current levels. In a report released today, New Street also upgraded the stock to Hold.
